question: What is the meaning of logistics in relation to design and production?
description: Logistics in relation to design and production involves the transportation and handling operations associated with system losses and the movement of products or materials to their final destination, such as a landfill. It also includes the traceability of products and materials through unique identifiers and the customization of the supply chain to align with a circular economy.
